name: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Call to Action
description: Adds an 'EPT Call to Action (CTA)' Paragraphs type: a title + rich-text + optional image laid out in one or two columns with one or two styled CTA buttons, plus the EPT family's shared per-paragraph design and button settings.
project_description: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Call to Action provides an 'ept_cta' Paragraphs bundle for building call-to-action sections: an optional title (field_ept_title), rich text (field_ept_text), an optional image (field_ept_cta_column_image, a Media 'image' reference) and up to two link buttons (field_ept_cta_link and field_ept_cta_second_link). Its ept_settings_cta widget (a subclass of EPT Basic Button's settings widget) adds a predefined layout choice (2 Columns, 2 Columns fluid image, or One column), content alignment, image position (left/right) and mobile image order, a mobile breakpoint at which the two columns stack, plus a full second set of button-style options (colors, shape, size, alignment, stretched, custom class) for the second link. Buttons reuse EPT Basic Button's styling, and the paragraph inherits ept_core's shared Design tab (margins/padding/border, background color/image/video, edge-to-edge, container width). Layout, alignment and button choices are emitted as CSS classes on the wrapper, while a small ept_cta.generate_cta_css service builds a scoped responsive <style> block (column widths, order, mobile stacking) from the settings. Requires ept_basic_button (which pulls ept_core), paragraphs, link and a Media 'image' type. Part of the EPT family — install only the paragraph types you need.
